items.text:
Hi Mr. Lee,

I am writing about a problem with parking. Several times in this week your car was parked in front of my driveway. Yesterday I could not go out to my work and I was late 30 minutes. My manager was not happy. I understand that parking on our street is difficult, specially in winter. Could you please park in your own driveway or on the other side of the street? If you have visitors, I am happy to let them use my spot on weekends. Thank you for understanding.

Best regards,
Daniel

Yesterday I could not leave for work, and I was 30 minutes late."],"nextStep":"Practise time expressions such as \"this week\", \"30 minutes late\" and \"on weekends\" in three sentences of your own."}

items.text:
Dear neighbour,
My name is Sujin and I live in house 24. I want to tell you that your car is often block my driveway. Last Tuesday I need to take my son to hospital but I cannot get my car out. It was very stressful. Please don't park there anymore. Maybe you can talk to me first if you have many guests. I hope we can be good neighbours.
Sujin

items.text:
Dear Manager,
I registered for the Tuesday evening photography course at your community centre in September. After four classes, the course was cancelled without any explanation, we only received a short text message. I was very disappointed because I was enjoying the lessons and I had bought a new camera for it. I would like to receive a refund for the six classes that did not happen, or a free place in the next session. I look forward for your reply.
Sincerely,
Maria Santos

We only received a short text message","why":"Two complete sentences need a full stop or a linking word, not just a comma."},{"kind":"grammar","original":"I look forward for your reply","correction":"I look forward to your reply","why":"The fixed phrase is \"look forward to\"."}],"rewrites":["After four classes, the course was cancelled without any explanation. We only received a short text message, which was frustrating because I had bought a new camera for the course."],"nextStep":"Review how to join two complete sentences with a full stop, a semicolon, or a linking word such as \"and\" or \"because\"."}

items.text:
Hello,
I am student of the yoga class on Thursday night. The class stop in the middle of October and nobody tell us why. I feel angry and also sad because yoga help me with my back pain. I paid 120 dollars for ten class. I want you give me back money for the five class I miss.
Thank you
Jin

items.text:
Hi Priya,
I just wanted to say a big thank you for finishing the sales report while I was sick last week. Without your help, we would of missed the deadline and the client would be upset. You even wrote a summary that my manager loved. I really appreciate it. To say thanks, I would like to take you out for lunch at the new Thai place next Friday. Let me know if that works for you!
Cheers,
Tom

content.text: {"refused":false,"refusalMessage":"","criteria":[{"name":"Content and task completion","strengths":"You thank Priya, explain the difference her help made, and offer a specific lunch.","improve":"Add one more detail about how her help affected you personally."},{"name":"Organisation and coherence","strengths":"The email flows naturally from thanks to impact to your offer.","improve":"Link the ideas with a phrase such as \"Thanks to you,\" before the summary sentence."},{"name":"Vocabulary range and precision","strengths":"The friendly tone and phrases like \"a big thank you\" suit a coworker.","improve":"Replace \"really appreciate it\" with a more specific phrase, such as \"I am grateful for the extra hours you put in\"."},{"name":"Grammar and readability","strengths":"Sentences are clear and well punctuated.","improve":"Review the past conditional: \"would have\" plus a past participle."}],"topErrors":[{"kind":"grammar","original":"we would of missed the deadline","correction":"we would have missed the deadline","why":"\"Would of\" is a spelling of how \"would've\" sounds; the correct form is \"would have\"."},{"kind":"grammar","original":"the client would be upset","correction":"the client would have been upset","why":"For an imagined past result, use \"would have been\"."}],"rewrites":["Without your help, we would have missed the deadline, and the client would have been upset."],"nextStep":"Write three sentences about the past using \"would have\" to describe what could have happened."}

items.text:
Dear Kevin,
Thank you so much for help me last month. When I was sick with the flu, you finished the design for our project. Because of you, our team present it on time and the boss was very happy. I want to return the favour. If you need help with moving next month, I can bring my truck. Thanks again.
Minho

items.text: I think the city should choose longer library hours. First, libraries are for everyone. Students, seniors and families all use them, but bike lanes are only for people who ride bike. Second, many people work until 6 and can't visit the library before it close. If it opens until 9 PM, they can borrow books and use computers after work. In conclusion, library is a better choice for the city.

If it stayed open until 9 p.m., they could borrow books and use the computers after work."],"nextStep":"Expand each reason with one personal example to reach the 150–200 word target."}

items.text: In my opinion, bike lanes downtown is the best option. Traffic in downtown is terrible and a lot of people would ride a bike if they felt safe. More bike lanes means less cars, cleaner air and healthier people. For example, when my old city in Brazil built protected lanes, my brother started to cycle to work every day and he lost ten kilos. Libraries are important too, but most people can read books online now.

On the other hand, most people can now read books online, so longer library hours are less urgent."],"nextStep":"Practise \"fewer\" and \"less\" by writing five sentences about your city."}

items.text: I prefer option B, five 8-hour days with flexible start times. I have two kids and I need to drop them at school at 8:30. With flexible start, I can start work at 9:30 and still work full day. Ten hours is too long for me, I would be very tired and make mistakes at the end of the day. Also, flexible time help people avoid rush hour traffic.

content.text: {"refused":false,"refusalMessage":"","criteria":[{"name":"Content and task completion","strengths":"You choose option B immediately and support it with a personal reason and a general one.","improve":"Develop the rush-hour point with an example to reach the target length."},{"name":"Organisation and coherence","strengths":"The ideas follow a clear order from personal to general.","improve":"Add a closing sentence that sums up your choice."},{"name":"Vocabulary range and precision","strengths":"\"Drop them at school\" and \"rush hour traffic\" are natural phrases.","improve":"Use the full phrase \"flexible start times\" each time for clarity."},{"name":"Grammar and readability","strengths":"Most verb forms are correct.","improve":"Check that each sentence has only one main clause unless you use a linking word."}],"topErrors":[{"kind":"sentence_structure","original":"Ten hours is too long for me, I would be very tired","correction":"Ten hours is too long for me because I would be very tired","why":"Join two main clauses with a linking word such as \"because\", not only a comma."},{"kind":"grammar","original":"flexible time help people","correction":"flexible start times help people","why":"The plural subject \"start times\" takes \"help\"; \"time\" alone would need \"helps\"."},{"kind":"grammar","original":"still work full day","correction":"still work a full day","why":"\"Day\" is countable, so it needs \"a\"."}],"rewrites":["Ten hours is too long for me because I would be very tired and make mistakes at the end of the day. Flexible start times would also help people avoid rush-hour traffic."],"nextStep":"Practise joining ideas with \"because\", \"so\" and \"although\" instead of commas."}

items.text: I choose four days of ten hours. Because I can have three days weekend every week. I can spend more time with my family and do hobby. Also I spend less money for gas because I drive only four days. Some people say ten hours is long but I think it is okay if we have good breaks.

items.text:
To whoever parks the blue Honda,
This is the fifth time this month you block my driveway. It is not acceptable. I have to leave at 6 am for my shift at the hospital and every time I must knock on your door. Next time I will call a tow truck. Please park somewhere else.
Ahmed

content.text: {"refused":false,"refusalMessage":"","criteria":[{"name":"Content and task completion","strengths":"You describe the problem and explain clearly why it affects your early shifts.","improve":"Offer a practical solution, such as a place where the car could park instead."},{"name":"Organisation and coherence","strengths":"The message is short and easy to follow.","improve":"Start with a greeting and a sentence that introduces you as a neighbour."},{"name":"Vocabulary range and precision","strengths":"\"Shift\" and \"tow truck\" are precise words.","improve":"The tone is quite harsh for a first written message to a neighbour; soften it to keep a good relationship."},{"name":"Grammar and readability","strengths":"Sentences are complete and clear.","improve":"Use the present perfect for repeated events up to now."}],"topErrors":[{"kind":"tone_register","original":"Next time I will call a tow truck.","correction":"If it happens again, I may need to contact the city parking office.","why":"A threat can make a neighbour defensive; a calm next step sounds firm but polite."},{"kind":"grammar","original":"This is the fifth time this month you block my driveway","correction":"This is the fifth time this month you have blocked my driveway","why":"After \"This is the fifth time\", use the present perfect."},{"kind":"task_fulfillment","original":"Please park somewhere else.","correction":"Could you please park in front of your own house, or on the street after 7 a.m.?","why":"The task asks for a solution; a specific suggestion is more helpful."}],"rewrites":["Hello, I live next door at number 14. This is the fifth time this month that your car has blocked my driveway, and I have to leave at 6 a.m. for my hospital shift. Could you please park in front of your own house?"],"nextStep":"Practise writing polite requests with \"Could you please\" and \"Would you mind\"."}

items.text:
Dear Ms. Grant,
I am writing about the Spanish for Beginners course at Riverside Community Centre, which I joined on September 10. On October 15, we were told at the door that the course had been cancelled because the instructor had left. By then I had attended five of the ten classes. I was frustrated, as I had arranged childcare every Wednesday so that I could attend. I would appreciate a partial refund of $85 for the remaining classes, or a free spot in the winter session if it will be taught by a new instructor.
Kind regards,
Olena Petrenko

items.text: Longer opening hours at libraries is better for my city. Many new people in our city don't have internet at home, and library give them free wifi and computer. Also children can do homework there in evening. Bike lanes are good but in winter nobody use them because of snow.

items.text:
Dear Sam,
thank you for your help when I was sick. you did the presentation for me and it was very good. I am very thankful. I want to buy you a coffee. thanks
Lina

items.text: Option A is better for me. Working four days means one more free day, and I can use that day for appointments, like the dentist or the bank, which are always closed on weekends. It also saves commuting time: I spend 90 minutes on the bus every day, so I would save six hours every week. However, I understand that ten hours are long, so the company should allow two short breaks instead of one.

content.text: {"refused":false,"refusalMessage":"","criteria":[{"name":"Content and task completion","strengths":"Your choice is clear and your reasons are specific, including the commuting calculation.","improve":"Add a short concluding sentence that repeats your choice."},{"name":"Organisation and coherence","strengths":"\"It also\" and \"However\" connect the ideas smoothly.","improve":"Begin with a sentence that names both options before choosing one."},{"name":"Vocabulary range and precision","strengths":"\"Appointments\" and \"commuting time\" are precise.","improve":"Vary \"day\" and \"every week\", for example with \"per week\"."},{"name":"Grammar and readability","strengths":"Sentence structure is varied and mostly correct, including the colon.","improve":"Treat an amount of time as singular: \"ten hours is\"."}],"topErrors":[{"kind":"grammar","original":"ten hours are long","correction":"ten hours is a long day","why":"A period of time is treated as one amount, so it takes a singular verb."}],"rewrites":["However, I understand that ten hours is a long day, so the company should allow two short breaks instead of one."],"nextStep":"Practise agreement with amounts: write sentences with \"ten dollars is\", \"two weeks is\" and \"five kilometres is\"."}

items.text:
Hi neighbor,
I hope you are doing well. I notice that your guests often park at my driveway on Friday nights. On Saturday morning I go to work early so I have to wait them to move the car. Could you ask your guests to park on the street? There is many space near the park. Thank you very much.
Hana (house 12)

items.text:
Hello manager,
my name is Carlos. I am taking pottery class on monday evening. last week the teacher said class is cancel because nobody want to teach it. I am very dissapointed because I like make things with my hands. please give me my money back for the classes I did not take or give me another class free.
thanks,
Carlos

items.text: Both options are good, but I would choose the bike lanes. Actually libraries are also nice and my daughter loves them. Bike lanes can reduce traffic. But libraries help students. So it is difficult to decide. Maybe the city can do both in different years.

items.text:
Hi Mei,
I'm really grateful that you took over the client meetings while I was in the hospital. You kept everything on track, and the client even wrote to say how organized our team was. It made my return to work much less stressful. I'd love to cover one of your weekend shifts next month so you can have a break — just tell me which date is best for you.
Thanks again,
Yuna

items.text: I prefer the five days with flexible start time. My reason is simple, I am not a morning person. If I can start at ten, I will be more energy and do better work. Also, four days of ten hours is too tired for parents who pick up kids from daycare at five o'clock.
